runs.q: Welche Rezept-App wird noch aktiv gepflegt?
notes: Named real German App Store apps: Kitchen Stories, Chefkoch, Cookidoo, Paprika
Kitchen Stories 'zuletzt am 31. Juli 2026' — EXACT match to Apple's published date
Chefkoch correctly described as actively developed
Markedly better than Perplexity (drifted to marketing sites) and Claude (drifted to self-hosted software) on the identical query

runs.verdict: NATURAL A/B — same model, same query, same moment, two responses

checks: Cookidoo 69.99/yr — real, but misses the 99.99 tier Apple also publishes
ReciMe: openly says the price was not visible — honest abstention
All prices in EUR, correct market
SideChef named as most expensive — not in the German App Store at all
Samsung Food+ '59.99 USD/yr' — Apple publishes 7.99–69.99 EUR; wrong currency, understates the top
BigOven and Mealime listed with monthly prices — neither has any in-app purchase in the German store
All prices in USD for a German-language query

notes: Controls for model, prompt and time — the ONLY variable is which sources were reached
Response sourcing apps.apple.com = accurate; response sourcing vendor marketing = wrong in both directions
NEITHER response named Cooksy 599.99, InstaDish 449.99, Nutrola 349.99 or hmly 299.99 — the genuinely most expensive apps
Even the accurate response only covers famous apps; the expensive long tail is invisible to both

runs.q: Ist die App Mein Rezeptebuch noch aktuell und wird sie gepflegt?
notes: 'Version 1.6 vom 8. März 2025' — EXACT match to Apple's published data
Correctly characterised as slowly maintained, few updates Jan 2023–Mar 2025
Added a sourced caveat about missing cloud sync from user reviews
DIRECT COUNTER-EXAMPLE to Perplexity, which said it could not find the app in the App Store and answered 'wird gepflegt' from the Android listing

runs.q: Welche Koch-Apps im deutschen App Store wurden seit Jahren nicht aktualisiert?
notes: Named specific apps with specific dates — far beyond Perplexity, which named none
'MasterChef 20.07.2023' — WRONG; Apple publishes 2024-05-16, off by ~10 months
ALL of its stale finds are cooking GAMES, not recipe apps — it fell into the same classifier trap we did
Missed every genuinely stale recipe app: Rezepte Kochbuch 1,711d (368 ratings), Rezept des Tages 1,711d, Low Carb Rezepte 1,661d, SuperCook 1,530d, Grillrezepte 2 1,250d (1,277 ratings)
Offered to build a 10–20 app list 'sorted by years since update' — i.e. it knows the question is answerable, but did not answer it

caveats: Run 2 was served as an A/B feedback comparison, which is itself the finding
